actionable_state_invariant: An existing held or retired campaign hit by the already-authoritative one-session <= -8% security break has ended its current campaign epoch. That same symbol should not be considered a new campaign merely because observed_trend.entry remains continuously true. A future fresh campaign must be edge-triggered after a later observed non-entry state and then a subsequent entry state. Fresh symbols without an existing campaign identity remain eligible normally.
evidence_limitation: Retrospective attribution on executed candidate1 accounts. PnL magnitudes explain failure concentration but do not enter treatment decisions or promise recoverable profit.

next_session_same_symbol_reentry_after_e.definition: Previous actual campaign security exit signal had p.ret1 <= -0.08, observed_trend.exit was false, quote remained ready, and the same symbol was selected again on the immediately following market session.

rejected_interpretations: Do not impose a market-wide post-shock cash cooldown: profitable fresh opportunities existed immediately after the same broad shock.
Do not cap refills to one slot: in common-five/removal the second contemporaneous fresh campaign sh603986 was the profitable leg.
Do not tune a waiting-day count or price-recovery percentage.
Do not reinterpret these realized PnLs as additive counterfactual profit.

chatgpt_5.note: Fresh sh603986 was not an existing campaign identity and later earned strongly; therefore a market-wide post-shock ban is not supported.

joint_optical_leader_removal.note: The immediate same-campaign sh688498 leg lost while fresh sh603986 earned; supports campaign-specific rather than market-wide reset.

september_2025_witness.observation: The -8% security-break predicate was true for 13 union names, all five common-five names and 10 leader-removal names while observed_trend.entry remained true for every listed shocked name. Thus security-break and admission-level state overlapped causally.
